entities.summary: Sophie Friederike Mereau was a writer associated with German Romanticism. Her maiden name was Schubart, but she did most of her work under the married name of Mereau. She also later married a second time, to writer Clemens Brentano, and took her husband's surname. She wrote novels, stories and poems, and she translated and published journals. Sophie Mereau was a poets & playwrights from Altenburg (1770-03-27, Altenburg–1806-10-31). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
